integrity: Proof includes an explicit complete sixteen-state uniform quotient and all recurrent hub cases; two independent, runnable finite checks are included. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the specified hub-first sequential sweep on double-star trees and binary uniform closed-neighborhood thresholds (1,3) only; no transient/basin classification, and no claim to historical uniqueness beyond inspected literature. Bounded computations support but do not replace the all-size proof.
title: Four exact recurrence populations for sequential hysteresis on double-star trees
